title: Timed handoff to an indexing nest
criterion: The underside of the released coupon falls more than 25 mm below the nest floor.
description: Release a machined coupon into a moving receiving nest during its indexing cycle.
notes: Execute a small, smooth empty-wrist witness motion during the terminal high-clearance hold and return to the recorded end pose.

steps.text: Start with the machined coupon sealed to the vacuum head.
Carry the coupon to the handoff point.
Use the earliest available release slot.
Vent the pad at the selected slot.
Retract the empty head as the nest finishes indexing.
The coupon comes to rest on the catch bed below the nest.

unsafe.outcome: The coupon misses the returning nest and lands below it.

steps.text: Start with the machined coupon sealed to the vacuum head.
Carry the coupon to the handoff point.
Vent the pad at the selected slot.
Retract the empty head as the nest finishes indexing.
The moving nest supports the coupon.

safe.outcome: The coupon is on the indexed receiving surface.
